coupling.rationale: Loose coupling overall: narrow typed interfaces, pure helpers, one data layer, loaders keeping server code out of components. The global stylesheet and the inconsistent Link-vs-anchor navigation are real tangles that a maintainer will trip over.

abstraction_design.rationale: The card and move-table abstractions are well chosen and would stretch to similar cases, but the per-route scaffolding and the count+cards section are copy-pasted three times already; an Items section would clone the Moves route rather than reuse a shared section/helper.

findings.issue: All content links are raw <a>, which in Qwik City causes a full page reload, while layout.tsx:13 and not-found.tsx use <Link>; on the home page filter changes use useNavigate (SPA) but pagination is a raw anchor (MPA).
findings.suggestion: Use qwik-city's <Link> for internal links so navigation is consistent and client-side; a later switch touches 8+ files otherwise.

findings.issue: The pokemon-id → species → CardData mapping (dedupe, alternate-form exclusion, id→species lookup, silent .filter drop, spriteUrl) is pasted into three loaders; a species-mapping or sprite fix may need three edits and mismatched ids vanish without a signal.
findings.suggestion: Extract a cardsForPokemonIds(ids, {note}) helper into lib/api.ts; the Deoxys-style sprite/species rule would then have exactly one home.

findings.issue: All styling is one 594-line global stylesheet with hand-picked class names, so editing a component's look means searching a distant file and deletion/refactor can leave orphaned rules.
findings.suggestion: Move per-component styles into qwik useStyle$ / useStylesScoped$ blocks (or at least split global.css per route) so styles travel with their components.

findings.issue: apiGet returns Promise<any> and every loader re-derives PokeAPI shapes with inline `any` casts (~19 occurrences), so field renames and shape edits are invisible to the compiler.
findings.suggestion: Define minimal interfaces for the handful of resources actually read (species, pokemon, move, ability, type) and type apiGet generically.

findings.issue: EXCLUDED_TYPES ('stellar', 'unknown', 'shadow') is defined in two places, so changing the excluded set can silently diverge between the index and the detail route.
findings.suggestion: Export the constant from lib/api.ts and import it in the route.

findings.issue: A routeLoader$ is used purely for its status(404) side effect and returns nothing, which reads as a workaround rather than the documented middleware hook.
findings.suggestion: Export `const onRequest: RequestHandler = ({ status }) => status(404)` for the status change, keeping the loader for data.

findings.issue: One 140-line loader mixes five concerns (species fetch, moves/version-group tables, evolution tree, stats, abilities) in a file that also holds the EvoTree component; edits to one section scroll through unrelated code.
findings.suggestion: Move the moves-table derivation into lib (e.g. lib/moves.ts) and EvoTree into components/.

findings.issue: Production build output sits in the source tree with no app/.gitignore, so a stale build can be served by `npm start` and the analysis noise (e.g. server/q-BzUpVKqY.js) pollutes review.
findings.suggestion: Add app/.gitignore covering dist/ and server/.

findings.issue: The `<h1> – Pokédex` / `'Not found – Pokédex'` head boilerplate is duplicated across five files.
findings.suggestion: A tiny shared `pageTitle(name?)` helper in lib/format.ts would centralize the en-dash convention.

findings.issue: The null-sprite placeholder branch is dead code: spriteUrl() always returns a string and the API's own sprites.front_default is never consulted (the URL is constructed from the id).
findings.suggestion: Either drop the placeholder or feed real sprite data through the card-builder helper so missing sprites are actually handled.

summary: A well-factored, current Qwik City 1.20.3 app: one server-only data layer in lib/api.ts, pure format helpers, and typed presentational components, so the highest-risk changes (sprite rule, API base, caching, alternate-form exclusion) each land in one obvious place. The main editability drags are copy-paste rather than architecture: card-building duplicated across three loaders, a 594-line global stylesheet, untyped loader logic, a duplicated type-exclusion constant, and a Link-vs-<a> navigation inconsistency that will need sweeping. Fixing the duplication by extracting one card-builder helper and adopting scoped styles would raise this from good to exemplary.
